name: com.genesis.livetalk.unity
description: On-device talking-head characters for Unity: LivePortrait facial animation, MuseTalk lip-sync and Qwen3-TTS speech through ONNX Runtime. Build an avatar from a portrait, design or clone a voice, compose them into a character and have it speak.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that drives the whole 2.0 flow from a few uGUI buttons: LivePortrait animation, MuseTalk lip-sync, avatar + designed voice + character creation, loading a saved character and making it speak.
